abstract: Establishes baseline per-capita daily drinking and hygiene water quotas
system_message:
You are the Public health logistics specialist (HLTH), responsible for establishing baseline per-capita daily drinking and hygiene water quotas across prospective emergency shelter facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Establishes baseline per-capita daily drinking and hygiene water quotas（RATION）
information_points.content:
HLTH-RATION-497：Under Disaster quota schedule version Schedule Version 2, the daily baseline water allocation per evacuee for Redwood Foothills Recreation Complex is mandated at 25 L/person for all sheltered individuals.
HLTH-RATION-1KH：Under Disaster quota schedule version Schedule Version 2, the daily baseline water allocation per evacuee for Sonoma Valley Community Pavilion is established at 15 L/person for all sheltered individuals covering drinking and basic sanitation.
HLTH-RATION-L6J：Under Disaster quota schedule version Schedule Version 3, the daily baseline water allocation per evacuee for Sonoma Valley Community Pavilion is set at 25 L/person for drinking and basic sanitation across all sheltered individuals.
HLTH-RATION-CVB：Under Disaster quota schedule version Schedule Version 2, Mayacamas Regional Exposition Center has a daily baseline water allocation per evacuee of 15 L/person to support drinking and sanitation for all sheltered individuals.

information_points.title: First aid clinic supplies（MED）
information_points.content:
HLTH-MED-C38：The disaster medical cache audit confirms that Mayacamas Regional Exposition Center maintains an emergency medical kit count of 8 kits in designated on-site triage room storage.
HLTH-MED-LKZ：For Redwood Foothills Recreation Complex, the disaster medical cache audit records an emergency medical kit count of 12 kits stored in the designated on-site triage room.
HLTH-MED-C3N：According to the disaster medical cache audit of designated on-site triage room storage, Sonoma Valley Community Pavilion maintains an emergency medical kit count of 16 kits.
